goal: Allow users and external services to manage prune locks via RPC to protect blocks needed for rescanning
Prevent unloaded wallets or external backends from losing historical block files during node sync
agreement: Support for enabling external wallets to build on top of pruned nodes via RPC (stickies-v)
Code approval after multiple review rounds (sedited)
Resolved objection: changed response from array to object for future extensibility (luke-jr)
Resolved concern: avoided data race when iterating prune locks (sedited)

Beneficial for external wallets building on Bitcoin Core, but reasonably deferrable
